title: manni evals strict (1.0.0-proposal.1)
description: The strict overlay for manni:evals:1.0.0-proposal.4. Stack it beside the open draft, which still owns every key, every required rule and every conditional. It narrows names to kebab ids and model ids, exit codes to the range a process returns, companion paths to relative ones, and the assertion hash to its full form.

evals.description: Strict narrows the object entries of the list. A string shorthand, alone or in the list, passes as the open draft reads it.

eval-suite.description: Strict requires a kebab suite name.

entry.description: The rules strict adds to an object entry, either a `use:` reference or an inline definition.

use.description: A kebab eval name from the config.

provider.description: A kebab provider name, such as `anthropic` or `llama-cpp`.

model.description: A model id of letters in either case, digits, `.`, `_`, `:`, `/`, `\`, `@` and `-`, with no spaces. A Windows path to a local model passes.

success-exit-codes.description: Distinct exit codes, each from 0 to 255, the range a process can return.

path.description: A relative path. It starts with no `/`, `\` or `~`, no drive letter, and no URL scheme.
